summary: Join our course tailored for new managers and supervisors. Develop key leadership and management skills to lead effectively and inspire your team.
lede: Leadership training for new managers helps newly promoted team leads and first-time supervisors shift from individual tasks to guiding team results. It addresses day-to-day people management through goal setting and role clarity, performance coaching and feedback, and delegation with progress monitoring. The syllabus also covers team communication and handling workplace conflict.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals moving into their first formal leadership roles or those seeking to formalize their management approach with evidence-based methods.
modules: Coaching Skills and the GROW Model
prerequisites: Participants should currently hold a supervisory role or be identified for promotion into a management position within the next 6 months. No specific prior management training is required, but a basic understanding of their organization's operational goals is recommended.
